title: Andersen-Gill model for recurrent events
summary: A population-average rate ratio for repeated events (admissions, falls, infections) using every event, with a variance clustered on the person.
_learn_page_pending: No Learn page on askmallard.com covers recurrent events yet. `learn` names the page that is planned for it.

sizing._why: Sizing recurrent events needs the event rate and its between-person variation; the Poisson forms in the catalog ignore the variation and under-size the study.

pinned_defaults: R: cluster = id, so vcov() is the robust (Lin-Wei) sandwich; without it coxph reports the model-based variance (0.0557 here against 0.0701).

Python: the point estimate from lifelines with entry_col; the robust variance WRITTEN OUT. lifelines 0.28.0's CoxPHFitter(entry_col=..., cluster_col=..., robust=True) reported 0.0472 here, smaller even than the naive 0.0557; a from-scratch Lin-Wei sandwich and R's coxph both give 0.0701.
